responsibility: Runs the coherence phase for impl checking in `rustc_hir_analysis` by wiring the relevant queries and enforcing the crate-wide rules that make trait and inherent impls well-formed and non-conflicting. This module coordinates trait-impl coherence checks in `mod.rs`, applies orphan and auto-trait locality rules in `orphan.rs`, verifies impl `unsafe` qualifiers and unsafe-affecting attributes in `unsafety.rs`, enforces the special structural contracts of built-in and lang-item traits in `builtin.rs`, collects and validates inherent impls and exposes per-type inherent-impl indexes in `inherent_impls.rs`, and detects duplicate or overlapping inherent impl items in `inherent_impls_overlap.rs`.
